scope: Focused isolated PostgreSQL Game Coin accounting with fixture native escrow/mailbox receipts; no live inventory or balances mutated, no blockchain

checks.name: canonical owner maps only to existing Game Coin account; explicit listing authority and exact native stock receipt required; CITY and extra starter accounts excluded
full-lot purchase atomically holds buyer coins; insufficient or second buyer refused; only exact backed-mailbox receipt settles conserved funds
lost delivery reply replays original receipt without paying twice; owner cancellation returns exact escrow to seller mailbox without currency movement
